M-C-46.text: Visual comparison with the independent Najaf: Maṭbaʿat al-Nuʿmān, 1968 edition, printed p.221 (Princeton/NYU canvas225), confirms the table alignment and the C-complement mark in the universal-affirmative predicate-obversion cell. Its both-terms-complemented cell still reads «ع بَ حـ», without the C-complement mark, so that English restoration remains conjectural. The 1402 printed edition itself has not been image-collated.

M-C-47.text: The independent Najaf: Maṭbaʿat al-Nuʿmān, 1968 edition, printed p.223 (Princeton/NYU canvas227), visibly prints «ب ÷ ٤ = حـ ÷ ٤» and «يحب / من يحب / يحب». These support the full division equation and the matching loves example in English. The preceding heading page (canvas226, between printed221 and223) retains «في النقض», so its contextual contradiction reading is still qualified. This is targeted earlier-edition evidence, not a full collation or verification of the 1402 print.
